'''Kemal''' was a [[Color/Legends|silver]]-colored [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Kemal Station system/Legends|Kemal Station system]], a part of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated on the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]], which linked it to the [[Andooweel system/Legends|Andooweel]] and [[New Ator system/Legends|New Ator systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Kemal was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the [[Water/Legends|damp]], foggy,<ref name="TEA" /> terrestrial<ref name="Journal6">{{JournalCite|6|The Greel Wood Haven}}</ref> [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Kemal Station]], which serviced both legitimate [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. Kemal itself featured a [[Mining/Legends|mine]] of [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]], but the output of the facility was relatively low.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kemal was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-16.<ref name="TEA" />
